office_does: The county assessor lists and values all taxable property in Columbia County each year, the basis for property tax bills.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Assessor Tammy Groom Ketterman, in office since 2023, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Columbia County Assessor since 2023 after six years as the office's chief deputy appraiser, running unopposed for another term.
highlights: Assessor since 2023; chief deputy appraiser 2016-2022; Walla Walla County residential and farm appraiser 1992-2000 [S1]
Pledges 'a fair and equitable valuation of each individual property' [S1]
Said in 2025 the county needs more taxable value, after the Columbia Pulp closure cut assessed value 4.46% [S6]
